description:
Complete the required feasibility and quality/performance decision for quantized, layered and QC-aware LDPC on the target host.

## Background

A float inter-frame decoder does not explore all available precision, schedule and code-structure choices. This mandatory bounded checkpoint evaluates those choices using the prepared canonical decoder workspace and measured profiles; shipping a new candidate is conditional, not presumed.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Satisfy the [Zen 3 measurement contract](dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/measurement-contract.md) for correctness, reproducible release benchmarks, comparison validity and adoption; receipts pin its committed version, the frozen protocol and the cell addendum. Include mandatory before/after evidence for production changes and preserve negative outcomes.

- [hard] REQ-02: Produce a required candidate decision record covering int8/int16 saturation/scaling, layered min-sum schedules and QC-aware intra-frame alternatives to inter-frame batching, with a fixed exploratory and confirmatory search/stop budget. Explain any design ruled out by compatibility or feasibility evidence; no qualifying candidate is valid, skipping the evaluation is not.

- [hard] REQ-03: Review numerical contracts and Rust 1.95 intrinsic feasibility before prototype implementation: signed-zero/tie rules, channel scaling, saturation/clipping, puncturing/fillers, variable-node accumulation order and per-frame termination. Use canonical safe library interfaces and isolated unsafe kernels with tested scalar reference paths.

- [hard] REQ-04: Evaluate bounded prototypes of feasible candidates on the measured DVB-T2 and NR workload cells. Include throughput, single-frame latency, batch fill/transposition, memory, iteration distributions and equivalent stopping. Compare separately with matched-algorithm and fastest quality-compatible measured external arms.

- [hard] REQ-05: Validate shared semantics and external conformance under each declared contract; report BER/FER counts and confidence intervals using random and all-zero codewords, punctured/filler inputs, mixed convergence and difficult frames. Predeclare quality tolerances; do not claim bit-exactness for a changed numerical contract without evidence.

- [hard] REQ-06: Publish measured proceed/no-proceed decisions and limitations for every considered family. For selected production candidates, provide a reviewed design and worker-sized implementation scope before delivery fans out; experimental prototypes do not silently become the production decoder.

## Notes

Pin exact source and build identities in the family addendum. Preserve unavailable, incompatible and losing arms rather than substituting a different operation.
title: Evaluate quantized layered and QC-aware LDPC candidates
